author: ezpz-content
instruction_bn: নিচের বিষয়ে একটি informal letter লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর checklist মিলিয়ে নমুনা দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a letter to your younger brother advising him to study regularly.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 March 2025

Dear Rakib,

I hope you are well. I have come to know that you are not studying regularly these days. This has made me worried. So I am writing to give you some advice.

Study is the main duty of a student. You should make a routine and follow it every day. Do not waste time on mobile games. Pay attention in class and do your homework in time. If you study regularly, you will surely do well in the exam.

Give my love to our parents.

Your loving brother,
Sakib
rubric: 'Your loving brother,' সহ নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing your visit to a place of historical interest.
items.model:
Rajshahi
5 April 2025

Dear Tamim,

How are you? I am fine. In my last vacation I visited Paharpur, a place of historical interest. I want to share my experience with you.

Paharpur is in Naogaon district. There stands the ruins of a great Buddhist monastery called Somapura Mahavihara. It is more than a thousand years old. I saw the high central temple, the old walls and many terracotta plaques on them. A guide told us many interesting stories. I was amazed to see the skill of our ancestors.

The visit was truly enjoyable and educative. I hope you will visit the place someday.

Your loving friend,
Nahid
rubric: 'Your loving friend,' সহ নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি
